title: SOME
description: some.it SOME Srl is an Italian ERP and financial systems consulting company founded in 2001 in Milan, delivering end-to-end implementations of Epicor Kinetic, Infor SunSystems and Fluentis ERP for manufacturing, hospitality and oil and gas clients. With about 22 employees and revenue of 2.8 million euro, it has completed over 100 implementations across Europe, the Americas and North Africa. The company operates both as a system designer building ERP architectures and as a local specialist adapting global models to Italian fiscal and regulatory requirements. Led by Sales Director Franco Giannini and Partner Hussein Bahobeshi with 25 years of hospitality ERP expertise, it serves international hotel chains, oil companies like Mellitah and ENI Congo, and mid-size manufacturers.
